in_sanskrit.name: Jeisha
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of wealth and prosperity
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Jeisha एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Jeisha is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Jaya', which means victory or success. In Hindu mythology, Jeisha is the goddess of wealth and prosperity, often depicted with a lotus in her hand and seated on a lotus flower. She is believed to bestow wealth, success, and good fortune upon her devotees.
